title: Parallel jobs run under an errgroup that is always awaited
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the job := job copy or the error wrap as noise. The copy is the pre-Go-1.22-safe capture of the loop variable for the goroutine closure (harmless on newer Go); WithContext means the first failure cancels the shared context so sibling jobs that watch ctx.Done() stop early; and g.Wait() is called on every path — it is what blocks until all goroutines finish and surfaces the first error, so RunAll never returns while work is still running.
